say:1:1720732001:1.text: Dura above, what can I do for you?

say:2:1720732002:1.text: Does the temple still provide shelter to homeless children? We found these children on the street. They're homeless and have been mistreated.
say:2:1720732002:1.source_cn: 我们在街上遇到了这几个孩子，他们无家可归，还被坏人欺负...

say:4:1720732004:1.text: But there have been more and more orphaned children lately, and we're already stretched to our limits...
say:4:1720732004:1.source_cn: 最近流浪的孩子越来越多了，已经到了教堂的人手远远不够照...

say:5:1720732005:1.source_cn: 这、怎么会这样……连教堂也……

say:6:1720732006:1.text: I apologize for burdening you with our troubles. As a servant of Dura, I should not turn away any soul in need.
say:6:1720732006:1.source_cn: 抱歉，作为女神的仆人，我不该拒绝任何一个求助的灵魂。我...

say:7:1720732007:1.text: I'm just worried we may not be able to care for them properly if they stay here.
say:7:1720732007:1.source_cn: 我只是担心孩子们留在教堂里，不能得到足够好的照顾。

choice_prompt:8:1720732007.text: I'm just worried we may not be able to care for them properly if they stay here.
choice_prompt:8:1720732007.source_cn: 我只是担心孩子们留在教堂里，不能得到足够好的照顾。

say:9:1720732008:4.text: Please... we don't eat much... and we can help with chores...
say:9:1720732008:4.source_cn: 姐姐……我们吃得很少的，也会干活……

say:10:1720732009:0.text: *Crying* I don't want to be homeless anymore...

say:11:1720732010:0.text: Oh, you poor things... We'd never leave you out on the streets, no matter what.
say:11:1720732010:0.source_cn: 傻孩子们……别怕。再怎么样，也比让你们流浪在外要好。

say:12:1720732011:1.text: Come with me, children. We may not have much, but you'll be cared for here.
say:12:1720732011:1.source_cn: 来吧，孩子们，虽然条件艰苦了点，但我会尽我最大的努力照...

say:13:1720732012:1.text: Thank you... for bringing them here. Dura will remember your good deed.
say:13:1720732012:1.source_cn: 也谢谢你们……把他们带来。女神会记住你们的善行。

narration:14:1720732013:1.text: The children bid you farewell before following the acolytes into the temple. At least they now have a place to stay.
narration:14:1720732013:1.male: The children bid you farewell before following the acolytes into the temple. At least they now have a place to stay.
narration:14:1720732013:1.female: The children bid you farewell before following the acolytes into the temple. At least they now have a place to stay.

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 他们都是很懂事的孩子

choice:8:1:2.text: They can take care of themselves.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 他们已经会照顾自己了
choice:8:1:2.male: They can take care of themselves.
choice:8:1:2.female: They can take care of themselves.
